options: A. Diesel engines use two spark plugs per cylinder instead of one
B. Gasoline engines rely on compression heat alone while diesel engines use electric glow sparks
C. Diesel engines use high-pressure air compression heat to ignite fuel without spark plugs
D. Diesel engines burn fuel outside the cylinder before pushing pistons
choices: A. Diesel engines use two spark plugs per cylinder instead of one
B. Gasoline engines rely on compression heat alone while diesel engines use electric glow sparks
C. Diesel engines use high-pressure air compression heat to ignite fuel without spark plugs
D. Diesel engines burn fuel outside the cylinder before pushing pistons
